eventDetail.scope: The topics offered in ICDSG fall within the IEEE areas of Computing & Processing, General Topics for Engineers, Geoscience, and Signal Processing & Analysis, with two dedicated tracks: Data Science and Geoinformatics. The Data Science track covers machine learning, deep learning, data engineering, big data analytics, visualization, and AI-driven decision systems for real-world applications. The Geoinformatics track focuses on spatial data acquisition, analysis, modelling, and the integration of geospatial technologies with AI (GeoAI), remote sensing, sensors, and engineering systems. ICDSG welcomes contributions that fuse Data Science, Geoinformatics, and engineering principles to address complex challenges. All topics align with the IEEE scope.
